editorial.blurb: Wong's serves genuinely fresh, made-to-order Chinese fare with crispy-skinned chicken, silky shrimp, and impeccable technique—a neighborhood stalwart that's earned its two-decade reputation.
editorial.insiderTip: Order combos (add $5.50) to bundle proteins with rice, egg roll, and soup—the portions are so generous you'll take home leftovers, and it's a smart value play.

topDishes.note: Tender chicken slices in glossy sauce, not heavy-battered.
